items.html: MY Reading Warriors

We offer Reading Program for Grades 1-9 for their Reading Skills Improvement. Our dedicated Teachers facilitate the learners to Read More, Read Faster and develop a habit of lifelong learning. We use various Reading techniques to help learners enhance their reading potential to the fullest.

 

We also provide K-12 Tutoring  i.e. 101 Tutoring Online & Onsite in Selected Neighborhoods.

​

We have a Team of Volunteers participating in our program as Mentors and Teachers. Join our Team as a Volunteer for our Reading and Tutoring Programs. 

​​

Follow on Instagram: @myreadingwarriors

​

items.html: Hilltop Tigers Soccer Club

We provide Recreational Soccer games for Age Groups: U9, U12, U16 & U19 that enrich children's lives. Hilltop Tigers Soccer Club aims to create an organized soccer program in the Hilltop area for less fortunate and underprivileged youth. By creating a club with quality programming, across all age groups and skill levels. We aim to develop highly skilled and confident players, who are ready to excel in the highest level of the game and in life.

​

Our Coaches plan and supervise soccer training sessions to develop physical fitness and specific Soccer Skills. Teaching social skills like discipline, patience, determination and teamwork are a part of our Soccer Club.

Our Soccer matches are played at Wilson Road Park every week. The teams also play friendly games and scrimmages at the park.

​

Join in today!

​​

Follow on Instagram: @hilltop__tigers

​

Contact us:
Soccer@MYProjectUSA.org

(614) 905-0977

items.html: After School Program & MY Summer Expedition
items.text: After School Program & MY Summer Expedition

items.html:
MY Project USA's after-school program has five locations, including four Columbus City Schools:

  • Eakin Elementary

  • Binns Elementary

  • Starling PK-8

  • The Hilltop Youth Empowerment Center

  • West High School

 

Students in the after school program engage in academic learning, tutoring, social-emotional development, technology exploration, and more, five days a week. Students at West High also receive targeted support in employment readiness and post-graduation planning, helping them prepare for successful futures. Looking forward, we aim to build more partnerships, offer diverse field trip opportunities, and enhance support for Columbus City Schools' learning strategies, especially for ESL students.

 

The MY Summer Expedition program expands ASP beyond the school year in the form of an 8-week summer camp available to students in elementary and middle school. Our Summer Academic Program (SAP), provides essential academic and life skills in a 
safe, empowering environment for youth. 

 

Program Overview:

  • Two four-week sessions for grades K-12, offering academic enrichment, STEM activities, and mentoring.

  • Engaging, Hands-On Learning

  • Activities include mural painting, 3-D design, tech exploration, and recreation, music, plus Social and Emotional Learning (SEL) with Generation RX.

  • Comprehensive Resources

  • Supplies include 3-D filament, drones, Chromebooks, recreation gear, and educational software licenses.

​

All students in ASP and MY Summer Expedition are provided with meals (two meals daily during summer programming) from our MY Community Cafe. 

​

Join in today!​​

​

Contact us:
Education@MYProjectUSA.org

(614) 905-0977

items.html: Under MY Wing

Under MY Wing mentorship program is a Youth Mentoring Program, College Prep & Career Counseling for Highschool Students Only. It envisions under-privileged refugee and immigrant high school students that are prepared to pursue higher education in the United States of America and prepare for a fulfilling career. 

​

Our program aims to expose students to not only in-demand careers but careers that appreciate diversity and contribute to positive social change. 

​

Contact us:
Programs@MYProjectUSA.org

(614) 905-0977

items.html:
MY Pathways
REACHING FOR SKIES

MY Pathways is a career guidance program that assists under-privileged refugee and immigrant adults and youth in getting equal job opportunities through guidance and a variety of resources i.e. Resume Building, Cover Letter Writing/Job Applications, Career Guidance, In-Person/Online job Interview Preparation, Online Work Profiles, Professional Styling & ESL Classes. Each individual develops communication skills through one-on-one and group sessions with the Career Specialist. We offer workshops that address Employability Skills and Career Readiness, Professional Morals and Ethics. Referral to MY Tailored Image for Professional Suiting and Grooming.
 

We also offer Online Conversational English Language Classes for youth and adults. We focus on functional proficiency of English Language. 

​

Register Online Today and come for Mandatory In-Person Registration at our location on Sullivant Ave.!

Through this program we aim to improve the quality of life. 

​

Contact us:
Pathways@MYProjectUSA.org
(614) 905-0977

items.html:
We offer Youth Suiting Program for Grooming, Self-confidence, Self-Care & Career Readiness. It is equitable and inclusive suiting program committed to elevating the refugees and immigrants disproportionately affected by poverty by equipping them with transformative skills and resources to look and feel good.

 

This program includes open access to professional attire, proper grooming and self-care routine, professional etiquettes and manners.

items.html: MY Leaders Lab

Our Youth Leadership Program is a transformative experience for young people entering grades 8-12, focusing on personal growth, community building, and advocacy for underserved communities and the minority population. Participants will engage in hands-on activities, workshops, and projects that empower them to become leaders who make a positive impact in their communities. The MYL Youth Leadership program provides a comprehensive leadership development experience that introduces students to the importance of leadership in their own lives, how to embrace their unique strengths and personality, and how to find who they are and wish to become.

​​

Follow on Instagram: @myleaderslab

Follow on Facebook: MY Leaders Lab

​

Contact us:

Youth@MYProjectUSA.org
